subject: BridgePoint co-sell — APAC facilitator handback & slot confirmation
messages:
From: Ravi Shankar <ravi@bridgepoint.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@bridgepoint.io
Date: 2026-11-09T02:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed APAC windows for co-sell demo and facilitator split

Hi Karthik / Vanessa,

Hope you're both well — BridgePoint is lined up for a joint marketplace demo with AWS next month and we wanted to lock the APAC-friendly windows. Our customer cohort is mostly in India/Singapore timezones. Two options that work for the customer:

- Option A: 2026-11-17 10:00–11:30 SGT (UTC+8)
- Option B: 2026-11-18 15:00–16:30 IST (UTC+5:30)

We'd like BridgePoint to host the first ~40 minutes (intro, customer business context, SI integration walk-through) and hand back to Redwood for the remaining ~50 minutes (deep product walkthrough + live Q&A). Can you confirm Redwood is comfortable with that facilitator split?

A few asks from our side:
- Confirm which slot Redwood prefers and any blackout windows for your APAC SMEs.
- Confirm AWS Marketplace/SI contact who will join on the AWS side so we can include them on the calendar and listing preflight.
- Any recording/consent requirements from Redwood we should be aware of (BridgePoint will record and upload to the marketplace draft listing).

Attached: BP-Preflight-Deck-v3.pdf (agenda + customer context).

Thanks — if either of those slots works we can send a calendar hold and HubSpot/MAP updates.

Best,
Ravi
Ravi Shankar
Partnerships Lead, BridgePoint Solutions
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Ravi Shankar <ravi@bridgepoint.io>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T05:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed APAC windows for co-sell demo and facilitator split

Ravi — thanks for the deck and the clear options. Quick responses below.

1) Slot: Option A (2026-11-17 10:00 SGT) works best for our APAC SEs; Option B is OK but conflicts with an internal training window. Please pencil in Option A as primary and we can keep Option B as a fallback.

2) Facilitator split: the 40/50 split is fine. Two small asks from Redwood's side:
   - Can BridgePoint host the first 5–10 minutes of intro + 10 minutes of SI architecture deep-dive? Redwood will start from minute ~45 with the product demo.
   - We prefer to keep the live Q&A open to both teams; Redwood will handle product/latency/cost questions.

3) AWS attendance: do you have the AWS marketplace contact already engaged? If not, please loop aws-marketplace@amazon.com and confirm an AWS technical contact (name + phone) — we need them for SaaS listing verification and to confirm any marketplace recording policies.

4) Recording: Redwood requires attendees be told recording will occur; BridgePoint's upload to marketplace is fine as long as the recording is accessible to the joint deal team (we'll need a copy for internal QA).

I'll attach a short internal runbook that lists roles (host, co-host, note-taker, recording owner) and a proposed timeline. Can you confirm once you've invited AWS so we can finalize the calendar and HubSpot actions?

Attachment: redwood-internal-runbook-brief.md

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ravi Shankar <ravi@bridgepoint.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, ops@bridgepoint.io
Date: 2026-11-09T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed APAC windows for co-sell demo and facilitator split

On Tue, Nov 9, 2026 at 05:37 AM karthik.iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Ravi — thanks for the deck and the clear options. Quick responses below.

Thanks Karthik — Option A confirmed from BridgePoint side. I've looped in our AWS contact (aws-marketplace@amazon.com) in the header so they see the thread; the specific AWS SES lead is likely to be Priya N. (I'll confirm name/line by EOD).

Two quick clarifications:
- Breakout ask: Customer wants a short breakout (15m) after the demo for technical deep-dive with BridgePoint + Redwood engineers — are you able to supply the Redwood SE for that window?
- Recording owner: BridgePoint will upload the recording to a private S3 bucket and share the link; we'll mark BridgePoint as the upload owner and Redwood as co-access.

We'll send a tentative calendar invite for 2026-11-17 10:00 SGT and include the preflight doc.

Ravi
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Ravi Shankar <ravi@bridgepoint.io>, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-09T18:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed APAC windows for co-sell demo and facilitator split

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Ravi. Confirming final details and the mutual action plan below (so we have this on record):

Mutual action plan (final):
- Calendar: 2026-11-17 10:00–11:30 SGT — BridgePoint to send calendar invite and include AWS contact when confirmed. (Owner: BridgePoint)
- Facilitator split: BridgePoint host 0–40m (intro + SI architecture + handoff); Redwood host 40–90m (demo + Q&A + next steps). (Owners: BridgePoint / Redwood)
- Breakout: 15m optional breakout immediately after session for SW engineering deep-dive (Redwood SE: Monica Patel). Please confirm Monica is good for that window — I'll cc her calendar hold.
- Recording & listing: BridgePoint will upload recording and share link; Redwood requires copy for QA and marketplace listing sign-off. (Owner: BridgePoint upload / Redwood sign-off)
- Marketplace preflight: Kimberly Park will run the listing checklist and confirm required artifacts by 2026-11-12. (Owner: Kimberly)
- HubSpot / legal: BridgePoint to update HubSpot deal BRIDGE-1876 with demo outcome; DocuSign MSA link (shared) to be completed if needed before marketplace listing.

Action items now:
- Ravi: please send calendar invite and confirm AWS SES lead (name + email) in this thread.
- Kimberly: will ping the listing checklist and confirm artifact list by 2026-11-12.
- Monica: if you can confirm the short breakout availability, we'll add you as the SE for the breakout.

Attachments: redwood-internal-runbook-brief.md, BP-Preflight-Deck-v3.pdf

Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short checklist doc in the morning.

Karthik Iyer
